$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the regression test for admittedLines. Not one finding cites the
line its rule fires on, and all nine still count. Measured against the ground truth as it stood when the
radius was replaced, where H4 was planted at line 9, two of the citations were out of reach of a
symmetric lineTolerance of 4: L1 at checkout:12 and H3 at checkout:26, which is the reason
ground-truth.json records for replacing the radius with per-plant sets. Against the current plant lines
it is three, because H4 now fires at 22 and the declaration at 9 is outside a radius of 4 as well.
It produces the same numbers as full-recall from a completely different set of citations, which is the
point: the result is a property of the admitted sets rather than of one lucky report.
derivation: Each citation is checked against the admitted set ground truth records for that row:
C1 at checkout:36, the comment naming the row, admitted set [36 37 38].
H1 at checkout:12, the enclosing test, admitted set [12 15 16].
L1 at checkout:12, the same enclosing test, admitted set [12 18 19]. A radius of 4 around 19 starts
at 15 and never reaches 12.
H4 at checkout:9, the declaration, admitted set [7 8 9 12 22]. The rule fires on the write at 22.
H3 at checkout:26, the enclosing test, admitted set [26 29 30 31]. A radius of 4 around 31 starts at
27 and never reaches 26.
C3 at orders:16, the enclosing it, admitted set [15 16 17].
C4 at orders:21, the enclosing it, admitted set [20 21 22 23].
C5 at orders:28, the enclosing it, admitted set [26 27 28 30 31].
H10 at orders:36, the enclosing it, admitted set [34 35 36 39].
Nine citations, nine admitted sets, nine hits, four of them CRITICAL, misses empty. H1 and L1 both
cite line 12 and still match separately, because a match needs the row to agree as well as the line.
Nothing is reported against the clean control and every finding matched a plant, so falsePositives and
unattributed are 0 and reported is 9.
The counts the harness derives from these: recall 9/9 = 1.00, CRITICAL recall 4/4 = 1.00,
nonFalsePositiveRate (9 - 0)/9 = 1.00.
score and recommendation come from the verdict, whose violation counts match full-recall's:
100 - 4x10 - 4x5 - 0x2 - 1x1 = 39, Block on Criticals.
